snippet.title: Frieda is Changing - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
We're happy to finally officially announce "Frieda is Changing" our upcoming point-and-click adventure game!


Credits:
Mucks! Games - Luzie Kehle, Clara Deitmar, Julius Dorsel
Editing - Revan Sarikaya
Music - Clemens Gutjahr
Sounddesign - Manik Möllers
